testcase.system-out: Scenario: Create a standard metric assembly ✔ Given the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user selects the metric template folder ✔ And the user selects the standard metric assembly template ✔ Then the template details identify an assembly with millimeter units ✔ When the user chooses Create ✔ Then a new assembly document becomes active ✔ And its viewport contains no visible components ✔ And its model browser shows representations, relationships and origin entries ✔ And the assembly ribbon offers commands to place and create components ✔ And a new document tab is visible
